messages:
Jon: Heads-up — Borealis (acct BOR-992) is 62 days past due. Invoice `INV-2024-339` for $89,740.
Marta: ugh. saw that pop on the dashboard this morning. any dispute details?
Nina: Reconciled yesterday — usage looks legit. They flagged a few test-run batches but not enough to cover the amount.
Sam (CS): Borealis rep replied: CFO asked if we can do a 3-month split-pay and waive late fees. They said ACH on the 5th of each month is fine.
Jon: Link to convo: https://redwood/notes/borealis-collections (internal). They want a written plan + confirmation today.
Marta: Our standard playbook allows split-pay for customers with good history, but waiver of late fee > $5k requires RevOps ok. @Priya (RevOps) — can you weigh in?
Priya (RevOps): I can approve a 3-month amortization but not a full waiver of fees > $5k. Suggest 50% fee waiver + one-time admin fee of $250. Also need manager signoff.
Avery (Legal): Is there any contract clause preventing us from accepting split payments? I can draft a short addendum with payment schedule and default language.
Nina: here's invoice snippet:
```
invoice: INV-2024-339
amount_due: $89,740.00
due_date: 2024-02-15
account: BOR-992
```
Marta: Proposed plan from RevOps: 3 equal payments: $29,913.34 on 5th of Apr/May/Jun, 50% waiver of accrued late fees (~$3,200 waived), admin fee $250. Requires Exec approval because net exposure > $50k.
Jon: I'll escalate to Execs now. Quick Q: do we need to block API access before payment plan starts if they miss first installment?
Avery (Legal): Add clause: missed installment = 7-day cure, then suspend access until cured. Also add interest at our standard rate if not cured after 30 days.
Priya (RevOps): approved in principle. Please include refundable security hold option if they push beyond 60 days.
Sam (CS): Customer is okay with the schedule but wants written confirmation of waived portion. They want it today to show CFO.
billing-bot: Reminder sent to billing@borealis.com (2024-03-05) - 1st automated notice.
Jon: Action items: 1) @Avery draft addendum and send to me for sign-off (by EOD). 2) @Priya confirm final waived amount and sign-off. 3) @Nina prepare updated ledger and set up split-pay terms in Stripe. 4) @Sam send hold notice timeline to customer after we sign. I'll ping Exec for final approval if we get green.
Marta: tagging legal + revops. If Execs decline fee waiver, offer their original 3-pay plan but keep late fees. Keep me posted.
Priya (RevOps): I'll confirm waiver numbers within 2 hours.
Avery (Legal): Drafting now — will attach here when ready.
